long_biography.plain_text:
At FedEx, Grover Trask combined line flying with technical work on cockpit information systems. As an MD-11 captain and electronic-flight-bag programme manager, he helped move manuals and performance tools from paper to onboard digital systems. He also represented Federal Express on the aircraft-performance group formed after a 2002 Boeing 727 accident.

In Sarasota, Trask served for several years as a director of the city’s principal boating club. He coordinated a Coast Guard captain’s-licence course that covered navigation, safety, first aid and practical experience requirements. In 2024, he joined a club crew for the Bone Island Regatta between Venice and Key West.
